column1: Only for the Jira and Confluence servers above whose certificate macOS doesn't trust; every other server gets the macOS checks alone. A fingerprint trusts exactly one certificate and is safer than a host; an upload that fails because of a certificate shows the server's fingerprint. Empty lists use the macOS checks alone.

Parmak izi tam olarak bir sertifikaya güvenir ve ana makineden daha güvenlidir; sertifika nedeniyle başarısız olan bir yükleme sunucunun parmak izini gösterir.
